purpose: User-authored enemy campaign layouts from the offline editor

fields.stage: integer 1..999; does not unlock a stage
fields.name: display name, at most 80 characters
fields.mode: optional free|player, defaults to free for legacy layouts; editor metadata and import validation, not a game mode
fields.baseLevel: optional integer 1..10; required in player mode; exactly one matching main base required for export/compilation

coordinateContract.anchor: max-x/max-y occupied tile, as in original TileHolder
coordinateContract.bounds: All occupied building and wall cells must be inside x/y 11..48 inclusive, from world1.tmx GameLogicLayer Building=1. JSON map dimensions remain 64x64 for v1 compatibility; original terrain and displayed grid are 60x60.

catalog: analysis/layout-editor/catalog.json: original unit_main dimensions and valid completed-building levels; construction placeholders excluded
guardContract: Base species typeid stays stable in editor. evolution selects original model; reborn selects original promotion within that model, both default 0. mutateId is original mutate_effect ID (default 0). Resolve actual typeid and original basic attacks from catalog.guards[].variants, indexed by mutation. Fixed skills: up to 3 distinct learnable skill families, encoded as family*100+level; validate hero compatibility and original levels. Omitted skills retains basic attack only. Import preserves all optional fields. Unsupported combinations are rejected by both JS and Python.

runeContract.slots: Optional array of exactly 5 entries; null means empty. Item item_form must equal slot index + 3. 45 original items, three types and three levels per slot.
runeContract.attributes: Each list uses IDs from catalog.runes.attributes filtered by its original layer color field. At most one value per stat in each layer, maximum 11. Missing lists are empty. hero_attr defaults to 0; otherwise must exist in exclusive_attribute. Manually authored attributes; not a reconstruction of random generation pools.
runeContract.runtime: Compile runes to eqp, preserving null positions and adding slot per equipment entry. Original HeroEquipment evaluates attributes and rune_order skills; do not append rune skills into the three cultivated skills. Missing runes leaves old layouts unchanged.
runeContract.preview: Longest matching contiguous prefix from slot 0; first null stops matching. Skill level follows RUNE_SKILL_LEVEL_RATE [0,0.6,0.8,1], limit 3; family 115 uses original replacement skills when defined.

application.registry: explicit marker block LocalNative.editorPveLayouts in native_boot.js
application.runtime: buildEditorPveVillage before existing stage fallback; registry empty until an approved file is applied
application.guards: unique battle SIDs and did mapped from anchorId; NO x/y on mobile heroes (no TileHolder); original _setupAllUnit uses did and setAtDefensePos
application.loot: original stage loot passed at runtime, not copied from reference screenshot
application.deployment: apply never builds or installs APK and never modifies device saves

playerLimits: analysis/layout-editor/player-rules.json: build_number counts at baseLevel, reachable upgrade chain using previous-level lv_up_able/rely_base_lv. Includes walls. Invalid player drafts remain editable but cannot export/compile. Free mode has no base quota; original catalog levels and geometry still apply.
